shortDescription: Brazilian conglomerate Cosan BMFBOVESPA:CSAN3 is in talks to sell 25% of natural gas distributor Compass BMFBOVESPA:PASS3 to an Abu Dhabi government-linked investment firm, Valor Economico reported on Thursday.
